Defect #155's direct cause: f73 ships alembic 0029 (features.project_id) and the live DB was stamped 0028. Booting the server never touches the schema, so /api/features and every 'regin feature' CLI read raised 'no such column: f.project_id'. Run 'regin migrate' on each install running the merged code. regin doctor now names this gap ('Database schema (alembic)' group, lib/doctor.py::_schema_revision_items) instead of leaving it to a 500.
